entities.name: profiles
entities.purpose: Primary internal profile root keyed by Clerk canonical subject identity.
entities.retention: until account deletion + legal hold window

entities.name: account_types
entities.purpose: Maps profiles to account and sector enrollment types.

entities.name: sector_publishing_permissions
entities.purpose: Authoritative publishing permissions per profile and sector.

entities.name: listings
entities.purpose: Marketplace listing records across sectors with mandatory pricing, location, and 120-day publication lifetime contract.

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_publish_expiry_120_days
check_constraints.expression: (published_at is null and expires_at is null) or (published_at is not null and expires_at = published_at + interval '120 days')

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_state_draft_null_timestamps
check_constraints.expression: (lifecycle_state = 'draft' and published_at is null and expires_at is null) or lifecycle_state <> 'draft'

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_state_pending_review_null_timestamps
check_constraints.expression: (lifecycle_state = 'pending_review' and published_at is null and expires_at is null) or lifecycle_state <> 'pending_review'

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_state_published_coherence
check_constraints.expression: (lifecycle_state = 'published' and published_at is not null and expires_at is not null and expires_at = published_at + interval '120 days' and archived_at is null and deleted_at is null) or lifecycle_state <> 'published'

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_state_expired_timestamps
check_constraints.expression: (lifecycle_state = 'expired' and published_at is not null and expires_at is not null) or lifecycle_state <> 'expired'

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_state_archived_requires_archived_at
check_constraints.expression: (lifecycle_state = 'archived' and archived_at is not null) or lifecycle_state <> 'archived'

check_constraints.name: ck_listings_state_deleted_requires_deleted_at
check_constraints.expression: (lifecycle_state = 'deleted' and deleted_at is not null) or lifecycle_state <> 'deleted'

entities.retention: active/published for 120 days then expire; archived/deleted per policy

entities.name: listing_media
entities.purpose: Stores processed listing image derivatives only with 4:3 ratio, crop/zoom metadata, ordering, and cover contract.

check_constraints.name: ck_listing_media_dimensions_positive
check_constraints.expression: width > 0 and height > 0 and crop_width > 0 and crop_height > 0

entities.retention: processed derivative only; temporary original discarded after successful processing
service_invariants: Publishing gate requires at least one active media row.
Publishing gate requires exactly one cover among active media rows.
Cover switch is atomic: clear old cover, set new cover, verify exactly one cover remains active.

entities.name: listing_publication_quota_windows
entities.purpose: Weekly publication quota contract enforcing baseline 4 posts per account per week.

check_constraints.name: ck_listing_quota_week_start_canonical_utc_monday
check_constraints.expression: week_start_utc_monday_00_00 (design invariant: week_start must be Monday 00:00 UTC canonical boundary)

check_constraints.name: ck_listing_quota_non_overlapping_profile_week_windows
check_constraints.expression: non_overlapping_profile_week_windows (design invariant under canonical [week_start, week_end) windows)

entities.retention: rolling weekly windows with compliance audit history

entities.name: trials
entities.purpose: Tracks a single base free-trial contract per profile with exact four calendar months duration.

entities.name: subscriptions
entities.purpose: Subscription contracts and billing cadence metadata.

entities.name: entitlements
entities.purpose: Computed capability quotas derived from active subscriptions.

entities.name: conversations
entities.purpose: One-to-one canonical conversation channel keyed by unordered participant pair.

entities.name: notifications
entities.purpose: Notification delivery and read state timeline.

entities.name: audit_logs
entities.purpose: Immutable audit trail for sensitive actions and admin operations.

entities.name: media_lifecycle_events
entities.purpose: Timeline of media state transitions and compliance actions.
